This repository is the **working space for writing the book**:

***Zero Services — The AI Reset of the Software Industry***

---

details.title: 📖 About the Book
details.body:
*Zero Services* explores a fundamental shift:

* From labor-driven software services
* To AI-powered, leverage-driven systems

It examines how AI is changing:

* How software is built
* How teams are structured
* How businesses create value

* Evolving ideas and frameworks
* Notes and structural outlines
* Experiments that support the book

---

details.title: 🧠 Core Theme
details.body:
> The future of software is not about scaling effort —
> it is about scaling capability.
